proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9757 matsara explicitly gives Sindhi macharu, Lahnda macchur, northern macchar and Gujarati machrũ mosquito/gnat. The selected macchar/machar/machriya series preserves that r-bearing family, with aspiration, vowel variation, rhotic notation and regional iya endings qualified. The entry discusses but does not establish a deeper connection with makṣa; this link does not settle it or local transmission. Exact response: məśər.
